messages:
Maya: LumenArc asking if we can stand up a short-lived customer-isolated POC tenant for a joint demo next Thu. Also want clarity on pilot pricing (hosted vs dedicated) and dropped a security pack.

Jared: I can provision. Prefer isolated tenant for demos. Need entitlement id, owner email, and SSO ACS URL.

Olivia: For pricing: hosted pilot + partner discount is quickest. If they convert to Dedicated within 90 days we can offer a migration credit. Ill draft numbers once we know expected qps and embedding volume.

Maya: LumenArc expects bursty chat during demo (~150 qps) and daily embedding runs (~40k items/day). They will accept CSV user sync for the demo but want SCIM for production.

Ravi: Security asks: SAML metadata XML, SCIM endpoint URL, SOC2 link, and confirmation no PHI. Also request pen-test contact. If standard questionnaire, security can turn it in ~48hrs.

Jared: Provisioning snippet (internal API):
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood.dev/tenants" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"name":"lumenarc-poc","owner":"onboard@lumenarc.com","entitlement":"partner_poc_shared_v1","quota":{"gpu_hours":80,"token_rate":150000}}'
```
Ill run after owner email and IP allowlist.

ops-bot: Provision request queued (req-id rq_a1b2). You will be notified on completion.

Olivia: Ill put a one-pager in here: pilot SKU, partner discount, Dedicated conversion terms, and a rough cost estimate.

Maya: Action items:
- Maya: collect SAML metadata, SOC2, and IP ranges (today)
- Jared: provision tenant once owner confirmed
- Ravi: review sec questionnaire and pen-test window (48hrs)
- Olivia: draft pilot commercial (EOD)

integration-bot: Tenant provisioning completed (tenant id: tenant_lumenarc_poc).
